description: Export artboards as JPEG files, one per artboard, at a quality and scale (100 = 72 ppi, 300 = 216 ppi). Transparent areas are filled with the matte colour

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

blur.description: Blur in pixels, 0-2, to reduce file size. Default 0

prefix.description: File name prefix. Default the document name

saveAsHtml.description: Also write an HTML page showing each image. Default false

name: export_jpeg
title: Export JPEG
